Finding the Length of a String Without Using strlen()
35
Problem Statement
Read a word and print its length by counting its characters manually, without using the strlen() function.
Description
Read a string word into a character array using scanf. Use a loop with a counter that increases once for every character encountered, stopping when the null character '\0' is reached. Print the final counter value as the length of the string.
Input Description
A single word with no spaces.
Output Description
Print the length of the word.
